# Sovereign Headquarters — Frameworks

> Open-source frameworks, magazine text, transcripts and research behind sovereignheadquarters.com
> and the Benjamin Riggins YouTube channel. Text is CC BY 4.0; cite with a link to the canonical page.

## Frameworks
- [The 3-Level Reward System](frameworks/3-level-reward-system.md): a 25-year North Star, milestones six months to five years out, and micro rewards for today, on a foundation of faith.

## The Sovereign Atlas (magazine), open text edition
- [Issue 01: The 3-Level Reward System](magazine/issue-01/README.md): eight articles (framework, evidence briefing, build guide, the long game, stewardship, Day Eight, open commons). Canonical: https://sovereignheadquarters.com/magazine/issue-01
